entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry to ask you out here so suddenly.
It seems like Makoto has[n]been waiting for me here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Being a chaperone is more difficult than[n]I expected. I've had a lot of meetings...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I honestly wanted to contact you earlier,[n]but this is the first free moment I've had.
You're doing great.
Let's enjoy ourselves, then.[clr 27]
I can't decide where to look.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That sounds lovely.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Stop it, you're making me feel[n]self-conscious.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All right then...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's take a walk.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, a food stand...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Garlic shrimp? I've heard that's[n]a famous Hawaiian dish.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you... adventurous when it[n]comes to food?
Yeah, sometimes.[clr 27]
Not really.
It depends.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's amazing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I always just stick with the standard fare.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're like me then.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It makes me sad when I accidentally[n]order something too exotic...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that so...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I usually go for the standard fare,[n]but this is just shrimp and garlic...[n]so I should be fine.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, let's give it a try...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: May we have two orders of garlic[n]shrimp, please?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hmm...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is flavorful, but I feel it's a bit too[n]salty for me...
We gazed out over the ocean[n]while we enjoyed the delicate[n]flavors of a foreign country...

entries.speaker: Shrimp Stand Owner
entries.en: You two from Japan?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah. Yes, we are.

entries.speaker: Shrimp Stand Owner
entries.en: How 'bout them Phantom Thieves, huh?[n]The guys that steal hearts!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How do you know about them?

entries.speaker: Shrimp Stand Owner
entries.en: Heard about it on the news![n]They're all the rage in Japan, yeah?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Seems like we're even making[n]headlines abroad.

entries.speaker: Shrimp Stand Owner
entries.en: Say, if y'run into 'em, tell 'em I say hello.

entries.speaker: Shrimp Stand Owner
entries.en: And ask 'em to change people's hearts[n]so everyone loves shrimp!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Of course, I'll do just that.
The owner gave us a heaping[n]pile of extra shrimp...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's amazing...
We gazed out over the ocean[n]while we enjoyed the delicate[n]flavors of a foreign country...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...How beautiful.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, it's already so late.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My sister would be upset if she saw me[n]laid back like this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To tell you the truth, I wasn't particularly[n]eager to go on this trip.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But if it's like this... I think I'd like[n]to come again.
It's been fun.[clr 27]
I'm good for a while.
Chaperone us next year too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, I suppose if we came too often[n]it would lose some of its magic.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know I'm graduating this year...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... I'd like you to have this.
It's a small wooden keychain...
Its dignified, yet warm expression[n]is reminiscent of Makoto...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's not the best souvenir...[n]but it will remind you of the[n]memories we made today.
I love it.[clr 27]
They're great memories.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank goodness.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, we should probably return[n]before it gets dark.
Just a little longer.
We're fine like this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I suppose I can't complain about that.
The two of us basked in the[n]stunning Hawaiian sunset.[n]Just me and Makoto...
